parts.text: Define enthalpy change of solution, $\Delta H_{\text{sol}}$.

parts.text:
The enthalpy change of hydration can be represented by $\Delta H_{\text{hyd}}$.

Write the mathematical expression for the $\Delta H_{\text{sol}}$ of $\text{NaCl}$ in terms of $\Delta H_{\text{latt}}(\text{NaCl})$, $\Delta H_{\text{hyd}}(\text{Na}^{+})$ and $\Delta H_{\text{hyd}}(\text{Cl}^{-})$.
